description: D-003 failure proof: the initiator starts the sole listen host and publishes its signed typed route, while the invitee's smoke-gated client startup fails once, clears its latch, and never retries.

required_lines: FRIENDPLAY: role=invitee invite accepted peer=0x[0-9a-f]+ rc=0
GROUP.SESSION: authority elected handle=0x07a68cc7 kbps=9000 local=0
PRESENCE: accepted signed match route authority=0x07a68cc7 flags=0x[0-9a-f]+ port=27212 fresh=1
GROUP.MATCH: join attempt authority=0x07a68cc7 route_kind=match-server flags=0x[0-9a-f]+ count=1
GROUP.MATCH: client join failed rc=-91; transport rolled back
GROUP.MATCH: authority latch cleared; no retry
forbidden_patterns: NET: connected to server, sending CLC_AUTH

required_lines: FRIENDPLAY: role=initiator invite sent peer=0x[0-9a-f]+ rc=0
GROUP.SESSION: authority elected handle=0x07a68cc7 kbps=9000 local=1
GROUP.MATCH: server start attempt authority=0x07a68cc7 count=1
GROUP.SESSION: published typed match route authority=0x07a68cc7 flags=0x[0-9a-f]+ port=27212

input_sequence.comment: Let the initiator publish the signed typed route and inject the non-authority invitee's client-start failure.
Hold long enough to prove the failed join remains one-shot while the elected listen host stays up.

required_lines: PRESENCE: accepted signed match route authority=0x07a68cc7 flags=0x[0-9a-f]+ port=27212 fresh=1
GROUP.MATCH: client join failed rc=-91; transport rolled back
GROUP.MATCH: authority latch cleared; no retry
forbidden_patterns: NET: connected to server, sending CLC_AUTH
